text: この　くみあわせだと　かつのは　むずかしいぞ……　ポケモンを　いれかえて　みよう！

structure.jp: この　くみあわせだと
かつのは　むずかしいぞ……
ポケモンを　いれかえて　みよう！

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after だ or a verb means 'if this is so, then that follows'. くみあわせだと = 'if it's this matchup'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. かつのは = 'winning (is...)'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: いれかえて　みよう
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means doing it to see how it goes, and the よう ending makes it 'let's'. いれかえて みよう = 'let's try switching'.
